name: Hypixel API
tagline: Minecraft network stats for players, guilds, and SkyBlock profiles
description: Public REST API for the Hypixel Minecraft network providing player stats, guild data, game modes, SkyBlock profiles, and server status. Developers use a free self-serve API key for authenticated requests against api.hypixel.net.

auth.details: API key via key query parameter or API-Key header; free self-serve keys from developer.hypixel.net

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free API keys with rate limits by key type; concrete free quota numbers not published as a daily allowance

rate_limits: Personal keys typically ~120 requests/minute; higher limits for application keys — confirm current values in developer portal
use_cases: look up a Hypixel player profile by UUID
fetch guild members and guild stats
get SkyBlock profile data for a player
check Hypixel network player counts and status
retrieve recent games or achievements for a player
